title: Location of commercial uses
previewText: For any large-scale residential development, the City Planning Commission, by special permit, may allow residential and non-residential uses to be arranged within a building without regard for the regulations set forth in Section 32-42 (Location Within Buildings) when terracing is required because of unusual topographic conditions in a large-scale residential development having a minimum area of 20 acres.
